summary: PLAN_ID=toolchain-workflow-repair; slices W0-W6; computes deterministic SHA-256 canonical-JSON identities; rejects absolute, parent-traversal, escaping, symlink, logs/, plan-state.v1.json, and resume-state.v1.json inputs; absent files are identity states; contract must match plan_id and contain slices; candidate paths derive from allowed_changes and planned_new_files, excluding globs and normalizing tools/; candidate identity includes sorted write manifest and recursive dependency hashes; predicate binds slice, contract, registry, and candidate; authority_root covers five authority/policy files; validator_root covers seven validator/router files; validator_version=toolchain-workflow-repair.validate-all.v1; closure hash binds slice scope and dependencies; aggregate snapshot hashes all W0-W6 identities; validator_hash self-identifies this file
